classification: post-hoc three-sleeve portfolio test using the R340 broad sleeve as a diversification source
hypothesis: Although the R340 broad quality-momentum sleeve failed its standalone selection gates, its 242-symbol breadth, low single-name loss share and moderate A/B correlation can diversify 5x-cost net stock P&L when allocated through dynamic three-sleeve risk parity.
disclosure: R340 E1/E3/E6 failed, so this is not a promotion of R340 as a standalone strategy. A static post-result arithmetic diagnostic suggested adding it at roughly one-third risk budget could lower A+B top5 net concentration into the 69%-72% range. R341 replaces that diagnostic with the real daily/monthly portfolio simulation and strict original-style gates.

window.reason: Common window used by the R339/R340 third-source research.

fixed_construction.stock_execution: T+1 open, equal weight within each sleeve
fixed_construction.sleeve_weighting: monthly 60-day inverse-volatility risk parity across A/B/C, each weight bounded [0.20,0.60], no leverage
fixed_construction.equity_risk_share: monthly equity sleeve at most 1/3 of total portfolio risk budget
fixed_construction.overlay: 60-day lookback, 15% balance-vol target, gross exposure [0.2,1.0], no leverage

data.D1: all three strategy files and required factors load without error
data.D2: all strategy sleeves produce curves over START..END
data.D4: mean pairwise daily return correlation across sleeves below 0.85

performance_2x.G9_incremental: Sharpe >= A+B two-sleeve control +0.05 or MDD >= control +3pp, while annual >= control -1pp
performance_2x.G10_no_leverage: max gross weight <=1 and min target weight >=0
performance_2x.G11_sleeve_balance: mean weight of each sleeve >=0.15 and <=0.60

costs.X2_5x_performance: total return >0, Sharpe >=0.50, MDD >= -25%, 2024/2025 both >=0, recent year >0

concentration_2x_and_5x.C9_asset_weight: each defensive asset mean <=40% and max <=50%
concentration_2x_and_5x.C10_liquidity: R331 primary asset liquidity gate passes
concentration_2x_and_5x.C12_weights: max weight sum <=1 and min target weight >=0

robustness.F1_fresh_starts: at least 4/5 fresh starts positive and every MDD >= -18%
robustness.P1_overlay_plateau: at least 7/9 combinations of 40/60/90-day lookback and 12/15/18% target pass core gates
robustness.P2_joint_target: at least 2/3 joint equity/overlay target variants pass core gates

selection_rule: All D/G/X/C/R/F/P gates must pass. Otherwise R341 is a negative result, R334 remains research_only_cost_fragile, and no third-sleeve promotion occurs. No threshold may change after results.
discipline: C is not promoted as a standalone strategy; it is only a portfolio sleeve hypothesis.
No stock-score, position-count, holding-period, sleeve-weight or asset grid is run.
No paper target or order file.
known_limitations: C is post-hoc and failed its own standalone R340 gates.
The common window starts in 2023, so this is not a full 2018-2026 validation.
The industry map and financial/custom factors are not full vendor PIT reconstructions.
ETF qfq series are not official PIT total-return benchmarks.
Static arithmetic motivated this round; only the full daily simulation can determine promotion.
